cases.note: tenant-manifest of TITU Work: the schema version Console binds a new tenant to
tenant-manifest of Admin: its own schema version and the TITU Work schema version it can read
Console refuses to provision Admin without knowing which TITU Work schema it reads
TITU Work migrates as the schema owner, so its bundle carries the owner password
an Admin bundle in the TITU Work slot
role names carry the application prefix
owner and runtime roles are separate
TITU Work needs the owner password to migrate
Admin gets its own bundle with the owner password and the TITU Work bundle without it
bootstrap Owner is created in Admin only
Admin reads TITU Work data with the runtime role; the owner password is never sent
the TITU Work slot takes a lobehub bundle
Admin migrates as its owner and needs the password
Admin's own slot takes an admin bundle
TITU Work needs the owner password
rotation of the TITU Work credentials Admin reads with, owner identity only
the TITU Work owner password never reaches Admin
expiry is evaluated by the application, so active may still list it
active cannot carry a manual or security freeze
rename: the previous slug becomes an alias
the current slug is never its own alias
name is trimmed and not empty
tenant id is the canonical UUID
the application already holds a newer profile and answers its values
errors are HTTP statuses, never a 200 body
a failure carries a code and no versions
Admin applies only after the connection validated

description: Messages of the tenant control plane. `accepts: true` cases are valid for the named schema in schemas.json; `accepts: false` cases must be rejected. Console's zod schemas are the source; TITU Work and Admin run their receiving schemas over the same cases.
